eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN IMMEDIATE EVACUATION NOTICE for the following counties or areas: Johnson, WY; at 11:57 AM on AUG 22, 2024 Effective until 3:57 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: EVACUTATION ORDER  RESIDENTS OF BUFFALO NEAR BUFFALO SUSSEX CUTOFF: Individuals with residences in the area of these alerts are under an evacuation order.  A shelter is open at Bomber Mountain Civic Center.  All other individuals are requested to remain out of the area.
